title: Change a service's price or details

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Services
steps.details: What the clinic offers and charges: price, currency, calendar duration, color, category and whether it can be booked online. It's the price list for quotes, invoices and appointments.

steps.title: Choose the service
steps.details: Tap it to open their record.

steps.title: Price
steps.details: The new price applies to new quotes and invoices; those already issued don't change.

steps.title: Active
steps.details: Inactive stops being offered without losing its history.
